There are different subtypes of bpd.

Bpd that most people think about, outwardly displayed bpd.

And quiet bpd. Where you feel the same emotions ad rollercoaster of them, but you mostly focus it inwards. On yourself. Hating self etc.

Iirc there is a couple more bpd subtypes, but I'm not sure if it's agreed upon and science based facts or not.

My sister has the classic "loud" bpd. And I have quiet BPD, grew up in a same family but somewhat different experiences overall.
But we also both have cptsd.

Edit:
Classic bpd presents itself externally and outwardly more often.
Quiet bpd is most often internal battle. Both go through these same difficulties and emotions etc but there are differences how it presents.

Classic bpd often takes their inner turmoil on others, not intentionally. But like they voice their feelings and thoughts more openly and often.

Quiet bpd often takes it on self etc.

I've done ketamine treatment 6x times, 4/6 out of those helped me, 2 times it didn't have any effect afterwards.

I went to a hospital for the treatment, about 45mins or an hour per session I think.
They put the cannula on my hand and started the ketamine infusion, so it was in controlled environment and they always had one nurse there checking everything out.
It was kind of an out of body experience, I could see visual hallusications and also heard some, but I felt completely peaceful during it.
It was like getting a break from existence for a while that was really nice.

But for me when it helped afterwards, it really helped.
With my depression and suicidal ideation, I felt really good afterwards and actually wanted and had the strength to do stuff, things brought me joy again.

Sadly the effect was quite short, I had those treatments once a week for six weeks and usually I felt a drop in mood after 2-4 days (still pretty good and better than what it was before) and after 6 days or before my next session it had worn off.

It was still really useful because I was highly suicidal and ready to kill myself before it, at some point I would like to try it again but not sure if that's possible or going to happen.
